name: Hollow Prophet
body:
School necromancy [curse]; Level cleric/oracle 7, lathspell 4, shaman 7, sorcerer/wizard 8, witch .

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as greater bestow curse except as noted above and instead of the curse options, the target is cut off from the ability to observe the flow of time and their third eye.

All divination spells cast by the target automatically fail.
